anomalie.title: Attendance anomalies
anomalie.selezionare: Select the month and the employees.
anomalie.notaRegole: Fixed rules (until yesterday): in red what blocks the payroll export (odd clockings, days without clockings, errors or days not calculated, pending requests), in orange the warnings to check.
anomalie.testoAI: Summary written by AI from the calculated anomalies:
anomalie.testoSenzaAI: Summary of the calculated anomalies (AI not available):
anomalie.metodoTesto: History from {{dal}} to {{al}} ({{n}} calculated working days). For each day the absence share is the ratio between justified absence hours and expected hours. Rate per weekday = average share (with fewer than {{min}} days the average rate is used); month factor = month rate / average rate. Statistics = sum, over the employees expected at work, of weekday rate x month factor. Planned = holidays and leaves in the vacation plan (approved or pending). Forecast = the greater of the two. Peak = forecast at least {{soglia}}% of the expected employees, or planned at least 2 and twice the average.

cdgCommesse.metodo: Staff cost = timesheet hours x hourly cost. Each employee's approved expenses are split among sub-jobs in proportion to the employee's hours in the month (no hours: default sub-job of the employment). Margin = revenue - total cost.
